card.text: Fast-spinning young Sun 54 parsecs away with a large dark spot over its pole, mapped in December 2017.

sources.label: Willamo et al. 2022
sources.quote: The brightness map is dominated by a large polar spot

introduction.text: HD 29615 is a young Sun-like star that turns in 2.3 days. Of the five stars in its study, it has the strongest magnetic field.

sources.label: Willamo et al. 2022
sources.quote: This star has the strongest magnetic field of the stars in our sample.

color.title: Colour
color.summary: The colour of the star's light, dimmed toward the edge by a model atmosphere.

radial-field.title: Radial field, Dec 2017
radial-field.summary: Where the magnetic field points out of the star or into it, mapped from how it polarises starlight.

meridional-field.title: Meridional field, Dec 2017
meridional-field.summary: The part of the magnetic field running north or south along the surface.

azimuthal-field.title: Azimuthal field, Dec 2017
azimuthal-field.summary: The part of the magnetic field running around the spin axis.

brightness.title: Brightness, Dec 2017
brightness.summary: Starspots: darker, cooler patches mapped from how they distort the spectrum as the star turns.
